core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghaydaa corresponds to the Arabic form غيداء (Arabic root غ ي د (gh-y-d); غيداء (Ghaydāʾ)). Its core sense is graceful, tender, slender. Ghaydaa (غيداء, Ghaydāʾ) is an Arabic feminine name meaning graceful, soft, tender — classically used of a slender young woman or a young gazelle. The source gave the unrelated غايضة in the script column and the gloss 'guide, pilot, leader'; both have been replaced.
